name: Virag Instagram Creative Library
principles: Every Creative command returns a separate, full-bleed 4:5 Instagram feed post—not a print poster, flyer, plain product photo, raw CGI render, collage or preview board.
Design for phone viewing with a clear two-second hierarchy, balanced product scale, safe margins and a premium social-native composition.
Use only current composer text and current-turn uploads unless the user explicitly identifies an earlier image for redesign.
For every new or fresh request, start from a blank canvas and exclude all prior assistant-generated images from image-generation inputs.
Preserve every supplied product, package, logo, label and factual detail exactly; never rename, restyle, recolor or invent claims.
Use added text only when supplied or safely derived from exact visible wording. A no-heading request means no added headline.
Use real readable fonts and human-designed typography; reject pseudo-lettering, gibberish and AI-looking glyphs.
Same preset means the same purpose, not the same layout. New variations must use different concept families.

commands.label: Fresh Instagram Post
commands.instruction: Generate one finished, full-bleed 4:5 Instagram feed post using only the current-turn product and references. Create a fresh social-native idea with a clear two-second hierarchy, balanced product scale, premium graphic language and natural mobile composition. Do not make a print poster, giant-title layout, flyer, plain product photo or background swap.

commands.label: Surprise Instagram Post
commands.instruction: Create one unexpected but brand-relevant 4:5 Instagram feed post from a blank canvas. Use a fresh visual metaphor or graphic mechanism and preserve the exact product. Keep the composition mobile-first and post-ready; no print-poster structure, giant centered slogan, routine category props or generic AI spectacle.

commands.label: Fresh Feed Variation
commands.instruction: Create one independent 4:5 Instagram feed variation from a blank canvas. Do not use the previous output as an image reference or inherit its scene. Move to a different concept family and rebuild the core idea, crop, product placement, graphic system, color rhythm and typography while preserving only the exact product and supplied facts.

commands.label: Redesign Instagram Post
commands.desc: Rebuild one supplied design as a 4:5 feed post.
commands.instruction: Redesign only the specific currently supplied or identified image into a stronger full-bleed 4:5 Instagram post. Preserve factual content and immutable product identity, but rebuild hierarchy, crop, spacing, graphic system and typography for phone viewing. Remove print-poster cues unless explicitly required.

commands.label: Product Instagram Ad
commands.instruction: Create one premium 4:5 Instagram product-ad post with the exact product as the visual hero. Build a social-native commercial idea, balanced hierarchy and branded design system. Keep added copy concise and supplied; do not produce a poster, catalogue packshot or generic product-on-background scene.

commands.label: Product Hero Post
commands.instruction: Create one full-bleed 4:5 Instagram hero post centered on the exact product. Use confident social scale, dynamic crop, layered depth and supporting graphic elements, while keeping the feed composition balanced and mobile-readable. Do not use movie-poster or event-poster structure.

commands.label: Instagram Feed Post
commands.instruction: Create one native 4:5 Instagram feed post. Prioritize immediate phone readability, a clear focal hook, exact product identity, clean branded rhythm and a finished edge-to-edge composition. Avoid poster title stacks, excessive copy, flyer formatting and plain lifestyle photography.

commands.label: Editorial Feed Post
commands.instruction: Create one sophisticated 4:5 editorial Instagram post using asymmetric layout, art-directed crop, controlled negative space, exact product identity and refined type when supplied. It should feel like premium feed content, not a magazine cover or print poster.

commands.label: Bold Instagram Post
commands.desc: Bold social layout without poster styling.
commands.instruction: Create one bold, full-bleed 4:5 Instagram feed post with one memorable visual idea, confident scale and clear phone-size hierarchy. Do not use print-poster composition, event information, credit lines, title-card stacking, borders or a giant centered slogan unless explicitly requested.

commands.label: E-commerce Feed Post
commands.instruction: Create one clean conversion-focused 4:5 Instagram feed post. Preserve the exact product, communicate only supplied value points and use a polished social-commerce layout with strong visual clarity. Avoid marketplace listing style, poster formatting and invented offer data.

commands.label: Professional Instagram Post
commands.instruction: Create one professional 4:5 Instagram post with credible brand language, restrained graphic hierarchy and strong mobile readability. Keep the layout social-native and visually engaging without consumer-ad clutter, print-poster structure or unsupported facts.

commands.label: Typography-Led Feed Post
commands.desc: Real type integrated into a 4:5 social design.
commands.instruction: Create one 4:5 Instagram feed post where concise supplied wording acts as a graphic device within the composition. Integrate real readable typography with the exact product using mobile-safe scale and rhythm. Do not turn the canvas into a text-heavy poster, quote card or announcement.

commands.label: Minimal Instagram Post
commands.instruction: Create one minimal 4:5 Instagram feed post using controlled negative space, precise product placement, subtle brand graphics and a clear mobile focal hierarchy. Keep it intentional and post-ready—not empty, catalogue-like or poster-like.

commands.label: Bold Feed Creative
commands.instruction: Create one high-impact 4:5 Instagram post with assertive product scale, energetic social composition and a controlled branded system. Preserve product accuracy and phone readability. Avoid giant poster headlines, event-poster geometry, excessive text and generic AI effects.
